data.Name: Restoring the Shrine
data.Description: Deliver the cleansing artifact to the shrine to lift the curse
data.Template_Text: The guardian is defeated, but [Location1] still pulses with dark energy. [NPC1] entrusts you with [Junk1], a sacred relic that can purify the corrupted stones. Bring it to the shrine and place it upon the altar before the curse returns!
data.2nd_state_Template_Text: You placed [Junk1] upon the altar at [Location1], and a warm light washed over the ancient stones. The curse is broken. [NPC1] kneels in gratitude as the shrine hums with renewed energy.
